title: sim struct sizes not statically checked against port struct sizes
description: The sim redefines each ioctl struct with a crypto2dev_sim_ prefix but uses the same CRYPTO2DEV_*_MAXLEN constants, so sizes match today. The _IOW/_IOR macros embed sizeof(struct) into the ioctl request code. If a struct in port.c ever diverges from its sim counterpart, the request codes computed by the port and by the sim are different, and all ioctls from the port silently return EOPNOTSUPP. The existing static_assert only checks sign_op==verify_op; it does not check that sim structs match port structs. Trigger: any struct field addition to one file without updating the other. Fix: add static_assert comparing sizeof(struct crypto2dev_sim_init_op) == sizeof(struct crypto2dev_init_op) etc., or share a single header. The shared-header approach is the correct long-term fix but requires the out-of-tree header to be available.
